notes: Single source of truth for water calculation constants. Read by the Node skill at display-time and inlined into the static dashboard at build time. Never hardcode these values elsewhere. Bump version when any constant changes.

ml_per_effective_token.basis: Empirical anchor from Li et al. 2023 Section 4.2, Table 3: ~500mL per 20-50 ChatGPT conversations (US data centres). Mid = 500mL / (30 conversations × 1200 tokens) = 0.0139 mL/token, rounded to 0.014. Low/high scaled by WUE ratio: low uses AWS modern WUE (0.18 L/kWh), high uses hot-climate max (4.0 L/kWh), vs central US average (1.8 L/kWh) used by Li et al.
ml_per_effective_token.calibration_note: The 0.014 rate was derived from total token count treating all types equally. Token weights below adjust the relative cost of each type — they improve accuracy when the mix is known but are not independently calibrated against a second empirical dataset. This is part of the ±50% uncertainty budget.

output.basis: Baseline. Anchored to Li et al. empirical figure (500mL / 30 conversations of ~1200 mostly-output tokens = 0.014 mL/token, treated as the 1.0x reference).

input_fresh.basis: Pricing proxy: Anthropic Sonnet 4.6 input $3/MTok, output $15/MTok → 0.20×. Theoretical backing: parallelised prefill is single forward pass, cheaper than autoregressive decode (Dao et al. on FlashAttention; Pope et al. 2022 on efficient LLM serving discuss the prefill vs decode cost asymmetry).

cache_creation.basis: Pricing proxy: Anthropic cache write $3.75/MTok, output $15/MTok → 0.25×. Cache writes do a full forward pass and additionally persist KV state. Corrected from 0.20× in patch 2 — earlier value was carried over from input_fresh without re-checking the differing cache_write pricing.

cache_read.basis: Deliberate empirical floor. Pricing proxy ($0.30/$15 MTok) would give 0.02×, but cache_read domination in long-context turns produced implausible totals (e.g. 6.6 L for one Claude Code turn under the original 0.03 weight). Floored at 0.001 to prevent dominance; the ±50% accuracy band absorbs the deviation from the pricing proxy. A v2 formula should replace this with a multiplicative cache_size × output_tokens interaction term.

model_pricing_per_mtok_output_usd._basis: Anthropic public API output-token pricing as a compute proxy. Pricing includes margin and is not linear with true compute cost — treat resulting multipliers as ±factor-of-2. Multipliers are derived at calculation time (model price ÷ baseline price) so a pricing update cannot drift from a hardcoded multiplier.
model_pricing_per_mtok_output_usd._correction_note: 2026-05-30: All prices verified against the live Anthropic pricing page (independent second source). Corrected from the patch-2 snapshot, which used several stale/mismatched figures: Haiku 4.5 $0.80->$5 (the $0.80 was old Haiku-3.x pricing; multiplier 0.053x->0.333x — close to the pre-patch-2 0.3x, which was roughly right all along), Sonnet 4.5 $12->$15 (0.80x->1.00x), Opus 4.5 $60->$25 and Opus 4.7 $75->$25 (the $75 figure was actually Opus 4.1's price; multipliers 4-5x->1.667x). Added Opus 4.6 and 4.8 at $25. Lesson: every pricing-proxy value must be reconciled against the live page each release, not carried forward.

wue_reference.source: AWS 2022 Sustainability Report p.14 (low); Li et al. 2023 Section 3.2 (mid = US average assumption); ASHRAE Datacom Series Vol.2 (high). Anthropic has not disclosed which AWS regions handle inference as of 2026-05.

validation.basis: Li et al.: 500mL per ~30 conversations × ~1200 tokens = 36000 tokens. Formula gives 504mL. NOTE: this validates arithmetic only — the anchor and the constant are derived from the same source. See methodology.md appendix for independent energy-chain cross-check and its uncertainty.
